# ToolRank

> ToolRank is a Sydney-based studio that builds websites, web apps and custom business software (browser-based booking systems, client portals, dashboards, internal tools) for small businesses, bands and startups: fixed prices, 1-2 week builds, full ownership (domain, code, accounts) handed over. Packages: https://toolrank.io/studio/ (Starter site A$499, Business site A$899, Web app / business software from A$1,990, Care plan A$29/month). Contact: hello@toolrank.io. ToolRank also publishes free, independent AI tool rankings by use case. Last updated 2026-10-20. Rankings are editorial; paid builds and sponsorships never affect rank; featured placements are labelled. Launch offer: free for the first 100 tools (including featured placement); after that, free listing plus paid options at founding prices.

## Categories


Audiences: 'For You' (consumer and creator tools) and 'For Business' (B2B and developer tools). 285 tools ranked across 16 categories; 0 approved user reviews.

- [AI Assistants](https://toolrank.io/best/ai-assistants/): General-purpose AI chat assistants for everyday questions, writing and thinking. 6 tools; #1: ChatGPT.
